perspective:
Carolyn’s available information:

- She is Carolyn Abebe, a Black woman bank teller with a bachelor’s degree. She works at a community bank with Marilyn Olson, a sales representative colleague. They recently started working together; Carolyn respects her and perceives a similar educational/professional footing.
- The bank has been unusually busy, with increased customer traffic and stress.
- Carolyn observed Marilyn being unusually quiet and withdrawn for several days, unlike Marilyn’s normally engaging demeanor.
- Conversation 1: Carolyn asked Marilyn if everything was alright and whether she wanted to talk. Marilyn said she was overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff, and thanked Carolyn for asking.
- Later, Carolyn experienced Marilyn as curt in an interaction. Carolyn felt confused and slightly hurt.
- Conversation 2: Carolyn told Marilyn she hoped she hadn’t overstepped, mentioned having had tough times herself, and said talking can sometimes help. Marilyn said she appreciated it, apologized if she seemed off, and said it had been a hard week.
- Carolyn felt relieved and hopeful when Marilyn seemed to respond positively. Carolyn invited Marilyn to a small weekend gathering. Marilyn accepted, saying it sounded lovely and she would love to join.
- Carolyn later perceived friendly interactions with Marilyn outside work, but at the bank felt Marilyn still maintained a professional distance. Carolyn felt disappointed.
- Conversation 4: Carolyn directly raised their work dynamic, saying she felt an unexplained distance. Marilyn said she didn’t realize it, apologized if it seemed that way, and agreed to talk and improve collaboration.
- After their private meeting, Carolyn believed they had cleared the air and better understood each other’s professional expectations and personal boundaries. She felt content and optimistic.
- Conversation 5: Carolyn proposed teaming up on the new project proposal. Marilyn agreed, said it was a great idea, was glad they had talked, and looked forward to working more closely.

Not available to Carolyn: Marilyn’s private personal details, hidden reasons for her withdrawal/curtness/distance, and any internal traits or feelings Marilyn did not state or visibly show.
